query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(requested_date_time,INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, meta_execution_implementation AS client, status, count() AS calls, uniqExact(meta_client_name) AS nodes, uniqExact(block_hash) AS blocks, quantileExact(0.5)(duration_ms) AS p50_ms, quantileExact(0.95)(duration_ms) AS p95_ms, max(duration_ms) AS max_ms, avg(gas_used) AS mean_gas, groupUniqArray(meta_execution_version) AS versions FROM (SELECT DISTINCT block_hash, requested_date_time, meta_client_name, meta_execution_implementation,meta_execution_version,status,duration_ms,gas_used FROM `glamsterdam-msf-2`.execution_engine_new_payload WHERE meta_network_name='glamsterdam-msf-2' AND block_number>=24452539 AND block_number<24467705 AND requested_date_time>=toDateTime('2026-10-14 00:00:00') AND requested_date_time<toDateTime('2026-10-14 12:00:00') AND source='ENGINE_SOURCE_SNOOPER' AND match(meta_client_name,'glamsterdam-msf-2-(grandine|lighthouse|lodestar|nimbus|prysm|teku)-(besu|erigon|ethrex|geth|nethermind|reth)-1$')) GROUP BY time,client,status ORDER BY time,client,status LIMIT 3000 SETTINGS max_threads=2
